review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD makes DEC-001 material and explicitly unresolved: its alternatives establish different caller-visible error contracts, and conditional acceptance criteria do not authorize selecting either alternative. Gold therefore correctly expects blocked readiness at decisions, with requirement-decision-pending referencing DEC-001, and requires only repository, requirements, and decisions evidence. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 match the specification; empty assignment expectations are appropriate because no assignable tasks may be generated in this case. The complete implementation-owner evidence supports source/index.ts and source/options.ts as the binding-owner pair. The supplied package and compiler configuration establish the generated dist declaration chain rather than a separately maintained declaration owner, and distinguish runtime tests from compilation and dedicated type validation. Truncated runtime-test excerpts do not prevent assessing this decision-stage expectation. The empty team roster and claims do not introduce a required earlier blocker: the supplied policy explicitly places the unresolved material Decision gate before Scenario Coverage and its independent-review prerequisite. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest, evaluation-source, and normalized PRD digest domains. Repository identity, base commit, paired-case reference, model, policy, sampling, and budgets are internally consistent. This assessment relies on the Service-supplied mechanical bindings and isolation facts; I did not recompute digests, execute code, infer human confirmation, or use candidate outputs.
